name: @r4-adapters/identity-http
description: R4-J4-R3 Customer Identity Authority HTTP adapter of the CustomerIdentityResolver port (MS-pesaschile-customer-identity-authority contract v1-d2, owner commit 7525395): POST /v1/identity/resolve with the agent bearer, the channel subject only in the body, deadline, 16 KiB UTF-8 cap, no redirects, no retries, closed validation against the pinned schema, opaque grant (transport shape, expiresAt and purposes only). Synthetic and loopback only. Transport only. Outside R4 Core.
